blocks.text: Electrostatics ya static electricity (ruki hui bijli) un cheezon ki study (parhai) hai jo stationary (ruke hue) electric charges se paida hoti hain. Is mein charges ki aik doosre par force, un ka banaya hua electric field aur electric potential, aur space (khali jagah) aur alag alag devices (aalaat) mein jama hone wali electrical energy shamil hai.

Hum parh chuke hain ke har charge apne ird gird electric field banata hai. Is field mein koi doosra charge rakhein to us par force lagti hai. Is electrostatic force ki value (miqdar) Coulomb's law se nikalti hai:

Is force ki direction (simt) charges ki type (qisam) par depend karti hai: dono positive ya dono negative hon to woh aik doosre ko dhakelte (repel) hain, aik positive aur aik negative ho to kheenchte (attract) hain. Is chapter mein hum parhenge ke charge apne field ke kisi point (nuqta) par kitna electric potential banata hai. Phir dekhenge ke electrical energy aur charge aik aam device, capacitor, mein kaise jama hote hain, aur capacitors ke kuch ahem uses (istemal) bhi parhenge.

blocks.prompt: Coulomb's law kya batata hai, aur force ki direction kis cheez par depend karti hai?
blocks.explanation: Do point charges q₁ aur q₂ ke darmiyan electrostatic force Fₑ = (1/4πε₀)(q₁q₂/r²) hai, yani force charges ke product (hasil-e-zarb, q₁q₂) ke directly proportional aur faasle ke square ke inversely proportional (ulat mutabiq) hai. Direction charges ki type par depend karti hai: aik jaise charges repel aur opposite (ulte) charges attract karte hain.

items: Electrostatics: ruke hue charges, un ki force, field, potential aur jama energy.
Is chapter mein: electric potential, capacitor aur us ke istemal.
